p_eff_counting_rule: one effective parameter per declared feature's own additive-monotone shape term (a single monotone transform of that feature contributes exactly 1 to p_eff); p_eff is the sum over the declared feature_subset of its declared shape-term count, never a fitted quantity. A richer per-feature shape (e.g. a spline with k knots) would declare k terms for that feature and requires the separately_preregistered_form_ref above to be non-null.
